summary: Packard: all 23 cards now carry production years, body types, rwd and period engine families from en.wikipedia and Packard references; 15 lines were missing years (e.g. hawk null → 1958, pacific null → 1954, twelve null → 1933–1939, 200/250/300 → 1951–1952). Make proposals: country null → USA, dissolvedYear 1957 → 1958; Predictor concept and 6 duplicate models proposed for removal.
